papers.title: Two-dimensional nanocoating-enabled orthopedic implants for bimodal therapeutic applications.
papers.abstract: As one of the promising orthopedic materials, polyetheretherketone (PEEK) has high chemical durability and similar mechanical properties to the cortical bone; nevertheless, the inherent bioinert nature of PEEK dramatically impedes its broader clinical applications in the management of bone infection. To address this challenge, herein, we developed a multifunctional two-dimensional (2D) nanocoating to assemble graphene oxide (GO) nanosheets, a polydopamine (pDA) nanofilm, and an oligopeptide onto the surface of porous sulfonated PEEK (SPEEK). The resulting multifunctional PEEK implants exhibited enhanced cytocompatibility, alkaline phosphatase activity, and calcium matrix deposition as well as osteogenesis-associated gene expression. Moreover, the animal experiments based on a rabbit femur defect model confirmed that the 2D nanocoating prominently boosted the in vivo osseointegration and bone remodeling. Besides, the GO/pDA hybrid complex anchoring on the SPEEK surface through π-π stacking can generate robust antibacterial phototherapy resulting from the synergetic photothermal/photodynamic therapeutic effects. Accordingly, this work provides a paradigm to empower inert PEEK implants with bi-/multi-modal therapeutic applications, such as against bone infection treatment.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PEEK植入物的纳米涂层以促进骨整合和抗菌，但未涉及LPBF制造或机械性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding analysis, no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PEEK植入物生物惰性和骨感染问题。
summary_zh.method: 在磺化多孔PEEK表面组装氧化石墨烯/多巴胺/寡肽二维纳米涂层。
summary_zh.result: 涂层增强了细胞相容性、成骨分化和体内骨整合，并具有光热/光动力抗菌效果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过兔股骨缺损模型验证体内骨整合和抗菌性能。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the bioinertness of PEEK and address bone infection in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: A two-dimensional nanocoating of graphene oxide, polydopamine, and oligopeptide was assembled on porous sulfonated PEEK.
summary_en.result: The coating improved cytocompatibility, osteogenic differentiation, and in vivo osseointegration, with synergistic photothermal/photodynamic antibacterial effects.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and a rabbit femur defect model were used to evaluate biological performance and osseointegration.
